name: Production Process Activity (Web)
implementation_notes: Pure static Blade view per tech-spec v1 — no Livewire component/controller/service/API endpoint; route registered via a closure (Route::get(..., fn () => view(...))) since Route::view() is not chainable with ->middleware() in this Laravel version

15 station tiles hardcoded in the view (3 active linking to route('data.weighbridge')/'data.grading'/'data.cages-track', 12 disabled placeholders looped via @foreach) — mirrors mobile's DEFAULT_STATIONS in localSchema.ts, not a database query

Icons are small inline SVGs (gauge/layers/box outlines) for the 3 active tiles — no icon library exists yet in the backend Blade layer, so these are hand-drawn minimal glyphs rather than a Lucide dependency

Sidebar link added to this view's own sidebar only in this pass — restructuring all other sidebars (adding this link everywhere, removing the 6 individual Data Browser/Input shortcuts it replaces) is a separate follow-up step
